notation.X_h: bitwise XOR of integer column heights; named X_h to avoid collision with existing X_feas residual-feasibility operator

transporter.canonicalRepresentativeConsequence: X_h is constant over every column orbit, so it cannot choose among permutations inside an orbit; at most it can bucket distinct orbits.

interpretationGuard: Exact finite 4x4 evidence. Solved values are derived only after structural coordinates are frozen. X_h is tested as a discovery lens, not assumed fundamental.
